purpose: Tokenizes card numbers (PANs) for payment services and allows conversion between tokens and PANs.

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: Behind the service there is vault-db (PostgreSQL)

flows.evidence: The PAN is tokenized by the card token vault and only the token is kept
Secrets do not appear in source code, configuration files, specifications or infrastructure definitions
Keys are managed in KMS, never stored next to the encrypted data, and rotated annually
